findings.title: TotalDocs reads cache without lock while BuildIndex writes
findings.body: bleveBackend.TotalDocs iterates b.cache without any RWMutex, while BuildIndex now does b.cacheMu.Lock()/Unlock() around b.cache[key]=idx. After the PR removed the coarse lock around the whole BuildIndex, concurrent index builds race with TotalDocs and with GetIndex. This is a data race that can corrupt map iteration, panic with concurrent map read/write, and return wrong counts when called from searchSupport.init logging.

findings.title: Concurrent BuildIndex for same key can duplicate work and corrupt file index
findings.body: The PR removed the b.cacheMu.Lock around the entire BuildIndex to allow parallelism, leaving only a short lock for the final cache insert. There is no per-key singleflight/dedup (getOrCreateIndex even has a TODO about it). Two goroutines building the same NamespacedResource can now both run bleve.New on the same directory, both run the builder, both Inc IndexTenants, and last-writer-wins in the map, leaking the other index. For file-backed indexes this races on the same on-disk path.

findings.title: Search watch goroutine never exits and panics on closed channel
findings.body: searchSupport.init creates watchctx as context.Background() and loops as for { v := <-events; s.handleEvent(watchctx,v) } with no ok check and no select on context cancellation. If the storage WatchWriteEvents channel is closed, receive returns nil and handleEvent dereferences evt.Type causing a nil-pointer panic. The goroutine also has no stop condition tied to server Stop, leaking forever and keeping Background-derived work alive.

findings.title: totalBatchesIndexed incremented concurrently without synchronization
findings.body: In searchSupport.init each errgroup goroutine does totalBatchesIndexed++ with no mutex or atomic. With initWorkers >1 this is a data race, and the span attribute namespaces_indexed logged at the end can be wrong or trigger the race detector.

findings.title: Integration test disabled for postgres instead of fixed
findings.body: The PR adds a skip for postgres in TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer with comment test not working in Drone. This removes coverage for the unified-storage startup path on postgres exactly when startup initialization behavior changed, hiding regressions the PR could introduce.

findings.title: handleEvent uses IndexMetrics without nil check
findings.body: handleEvent calls IndexMetrics.IndexedKinds.Inc/Dec and IndexMetrics.IndexLatency.Observe unconditionally, while init guards with if IndexMetrics != nil. If metrics are not registered (tests, nil global), any watch event panics the background indexing goroutine and kills search updates.
